name: live-static-preview
description: A CodePen-style live HTML/CSS/JS preview tool built with vanilla JS + CodeMirror 6. Runs with no build step.
comment: DEFAULT MODE NEEDS NO INSTALL: `npm start` just serves the files; CodeMirror loads from the CDN via the import map in index.html. The devDependencies below are ONLY for the optional Vite build path (npm install && npm run build), which vendors CodeMirror and removes the CDN dependency.
